title: Queue a graph from a script

questions.q: Why copy the loaded graph before setting values?
options: Otherwise one job's values carry into the next
questions.answer: Otherwise one job's values carry into the next
questions.why: A loop editing one dict keeps every change it has made.

questions.q: Why connect the websocket before posting?
options: Messages for a client with no socket are dropped
questions.answer: Messages for a client with no socket are dropped
questions.why: send_json only sends if the id is in self.sockets.

questions.q: Which prompt_id would the server accept?
questions.why: validate_job_id wants a UUID in lowercase hyphenated form. The one with no hyphens fails.

questions.q: You want to keep only saved pictures. How do you tell them apart in the history?
options: type is output, and previews say temp
questions.answer: type is output, and previews say temp
questions.why: Each file entry has filename, subfolder and type.

questions.q: Every run gives the same picture almost at once. Why?
options: The seed did not change, so everything was cached
questions.answer: The seed did not change, so everything was cached
questions.why: The API format has only a number. Your script must set a new one.
